exposure: BMI category (normal, mild underweight, severe to moderate underweight)
Women with severe to moderate underweight
finding: Maternal underweight, particularly severe thinness, was associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery and intrauterine growth retardation, but not with caesarean section or scheduled labor.
mod_finding: The risk of cesarean section was not different between women with normal BMI and those with BMI < 18.5.
